meta.title: Aimoto — Bitcoin Forecasting and Backtesting Lab

seo.title: Aimoto — Bitcoin forecasting lab
seo.description: A local Bitcoin research lab for market data, predictive models, historical backtesting and execution tracking.

hero.hook: Experiment with Bitcoin models, then test them against historical data.
hero.description: Aimoto brings together data preparation, daily forecasting, backtesting and result comparison in a local research interface.

visual.alt: Aimoto presentation montage: a historical Bitcoin forecast preview displayed on a laptop.

overview.problem: Evaluating Bitcoin forecasting approaches requires preparing time series, repeating experiments and comparing results without mixing training and evaluation data.
overview.solution: A local application connects market data, configurable models, a backtesting engine and comparison views to support the complete experimental workflow.
overview.audience: Technical users exploring Bitcoin forecasts and strategies
overview.role: Development and evolution of application interfaces and services
overview.scope: Next.js interface, Python API, asynchronous jobs and historical evaluation

visual.title: Datasets and features
visual.description: Import or refresh daily series and select the features used in experiments. Feature catalogue, data providers and freshness indicators.

visual.title: Guided configuration
visual.description: Choose the mode, dates, features, model and parameters before starting a run. A step-by-step run creation flow.

visual.title: Job queue
visual.description: Inspect the job queue, execution stages, progress and error states. Server-sent job updates with polling as a fallback.

visual.title: Results and comparisons
visual.description: Explore forecasts, scores and previous runs, then refine the starting assumptions. Forecast visualizations, leaderboard and run details.

architecture.description: The interface calls a local API that orchestrates computations and persists experiment metadata and artifacts.

nodes.label: Local storage
nodes.role: Store execution states, metrics and artifacts

challenges.title: Avoid temporal data leakage
challenges.constraint: Time-series backtests can be biased if future observations leak into training.
challenges.solution: Date-based walk-forward splits and explicit availability lags for features.

challenges.title: Track long-running jobs
challenges.constraint: Model training and calculations can outlive HTTP requests and may be interrupted.
challenges.solution: A job queue, separate worker, states and progress tracking, with SSE updates and polling fallback in the interface.

challenges.title: Keep artifacts consistent
challenges.constraint: An interrupted write can leave incomplete result files.
challenges.solution: Validated temporary JSON writes followed by atomic replacement, fsync and targeted retries for I/O errors.

outcomes.title: Guided experiments
outcomes.description: Run configuration flows and a batch matrix of feature and model combinations.

outcomes.title: Backtesting and comparison
outcomes.description: Forecasting and backtesting engines, run history, leaderboard and result visualizations.

outcomes.title: Execution monitoring
outcomes.description: A job queue, computation stages and status updates surfaced in the interface.
